reviews.text: Wonderful veterinarians. You can tell they love animals. They dedicate the necessary time to each one.

Friends recommended this clinic to me, and it absolutely lived up to my expectations. I came for my first checkup with my puppy and for vaccinations. They explained everything, helped me with all the paperwork for my insurance company and for registering the puppy in this region. Their attitude towards animals is superb.

Professional doctor, quickly provided assistance and advice.
I recommend

They are exceptional veterinarians! My cat was suffering from tartar buildup and needed teeth extracted, so blood work was scheduled, and depending on the results, surgery was planned. Everything went well. I also came in one day for an emergency urinary tract infection for my cat. Everything was checked with an ultrasound, and he was treated and recovered. The prices are fair, and the quality of their work is evident!

They are very kind, honest, and responsible.

Besides being excellent veterinarians and having great, always very clean facilities, they offer a wide variety of services and speak Russian and other languages. Highly recommended.
We're happy. Our cat is back to normal. We're very grateful to Natalia and the wonderful doctors.
I had my two Bull Terriers neutered here, one year apart. Everything was done professionally, with no issues or complaints.

We had our cat spayed here and the experience was excellent. Everything went very well and she recovered perfectly. Natalia always responded quickly to our questions, adapted to our needs, and supported us throughout the entire process. Highly recommended.
I highly recommend them! Always available, they help promptly in any situation, and are incredibly attentive to each animal.

They are incredible!!! I have no words to thank them for everything they do. Their love for animals goes beyond their work; they are truly involved, they care, and they help you with everything with so much love. Excellent professionals. Highly recommended.

Excellent veterinary clinic. The staff speaks Russian, which is very convenient. They always have the necessary medications in stock and provide prompt and professional assistance. It's easy to get an appointment at a convenient time, so there are rarely any waits or long queues. Many thanks to the veterinarians and the entire team for their care and attention to the pets. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Excellent service, fair prices. My favorite vet.
Everything was great and reasonably priced.
Best vet in Valencia!!!
Best vet in town!

Excellent clinic. The vet was very kind and advised us on everything we needed to know about my cats. It's clear they have a lot of experience and empathy with animals. Highly recommended if you're looking for professional and honest service in Valencia. Thank you so much!
Excellent staff working there
Wonderful clinic and professional doctors. They helped me get my elderly cat back on his feet. They're very attentive and caring towards animals.
The doctor is such a wonderful person; he did everything for my dog, and he's healed. Thank you so much!

Very kind, they take their time to understand and see what's wrong with your pet, and the treatments are affordable!
Very empathetic and humane with pets. My dog ​​Leia and I will definitely be back!
We are very happy with the service we receive. Every time we take Turrón, the care and professionalism with which they treat him is priceless. Great professionals.

They've become my go-to veterinary clinic. Miguel and Nataliya are excellent professionals and, above all, very caring. They've treated us with great dedication and take the time to assess your pet and explain everything clearly. After some disappointments at our previous clinic, I'm absolutely certain we've found the right place.
I can only express my heartfelt gratitude for healing my cat ❤️ Natalia is the best veterinarian in the world
Wonderful clinic, very nice girl Natalia, speaks Russian. They treated our little peach quickly and safely.
A very good veterinary clinic. Excellent service. Natalia and her husband are great professionals. Always attentive and caring. They make accurate and quick diagnoses.

Very professional and kind. My dog ​​had severe diarrhea and was even bleeding from his rear end, and a veterinarian attended to both me and my dog ​​throughout the entire process. She gave him an injection for the diarrhea, and it stopped the next day with no more bleeding. She also gave me several packets of medication, and the price was affordable and not expensive. Although my dog ​​was reluctant to take the medication, he has recovered. Thank you so much 🙏

I took my healthy Yorkshire Terrier, Laia, to be spayed, and they returned her to me in a box.
September 9th of this year, 2025, marked a year since her disappearance, and their response is that they don't know what happened.
After more than 20 years of friendship, this is the biggest slap in the face I've ever received, as all I got was an "I'm sorry." That's all my 3-year-old dog is worth to them. An "I'm sorry," and they don't know what happened.
I'm still heartbroken. She was only 3 years old, and yet everything has been left like this, with no rights whatsoever.
I'm giving one star because it's required to post, but I wouldn't just remove all the stars, I'd give five negative ones. 😞😞😞😞😞 (These are my stars)

Natalia pulled my beloved cat back from the brink of death, literally by the tail, in his final moments after "treatment" at another Spanish clinic. Now he's running around on the ceiling, eating like three men, and purring right next to me.
God bless you 😘❤️

Our dog had a skin growth removed and received a professional dental cleaning under anesthesia. We plan to have him chemically neutered. It's a good clinic with friendly and attentive staff and very professional veterinarians. Everything went very well. Fair prices and a good range of services. Mrs. Nataliya speaks Russian. I definitely recommend it!

🐾 🌍 The most reliable choice for traveling with pets abroad
- Spanish abajo 👇

We contacted this clinic to obtain a certificate for travel to Israel. Since we often fly abroad with our pets, we know how complicated and demanding this procedure is: there's a lot of bureaucracy, and every detail matters. So, we were looking for a truly reliable clinic—and we weren't disappointed.
All the paperwork was completed very carefully and attentively, every step was completed correctly and on time. Natalia explained everything in detail in Russian, and her husband handled the paperwork in Spanish and interacted with local authorities.
In the end, everything went perfectly. We will definitely return and recommend this clinic to anyone traveling with animals. The professionalism and genuine care are evident here.

⸻

🇪🇸 Español
Acudimos a esta clínica para tramitar el certificado de salida a Israel. Como solemos viajar al extranjero con nuestra mascota, sabemos lo complejo y delicado que puede ser este proceso: mucha burocracia y cada detalle cuenta. Por eso buscábamos una clínica de confianza - y no nos equivocamos.
Todos los documentos se prepararon con mucho cuidado y atención; cada paso se hizo de manera correcta y puntual. Natalia nos explicó todo en ruso, y su esposo gestionó los trámites en español y con las autoridades locales.
El resultado fue perfecto. Sin duda volveremos y recomendamos esta clínica a todos los que viajan con sus animales. Aquí se nota el profesionalismo y la verdadera dedicación.
Tea makers, experts in their field. I recommend.

High-quality medical care, a correct diagnosis, and tender care—I found all this at this clinic when I brought my cat in for an appointment. They speak Russian and Spanish. This clinic and its doctors are the only ones I can trust with my cat's life.
I called them on the phone and they helped me and made things easy for me at all times, I am very grateful.

Excellent service. We went without an appointment because of a problem with our puppy, which the doctor resolved. We are so grateful for the care and dedication shown to our dog. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic. The service is unbeatable.
They're great. They provide incredibly friendly and professional service.

Absolutely fantastic! 👏🏻
I returned to my neighborhood after 20 years with my dog ​​and my mixed-breed dogs and didn't know where to go. I went in a very difficult situation with my mastiff, who was very sick, and they helped us a lot with the difficult time of saying goodbye. I'm a vet who loves dogs, so I pay close attention to everything, and of all the clinics I've been to, I feel lucky to have them here nearby. 🫶🏻
In a few weeks, I have to take my four mixed-breed dogs for checkups, and I feel very reassured knowing I have a trustworthy place.
The truth is, I can only thank Miguel and Natasha. 🙏🏻

And a big kiss to Charlie, who is such a sweetheart. 💖
I recommend this clinic to everyone in the Monteolivete neighborhood and surrounding areas. They are next to Carglass.
Thank you from Luis and me.
Sincerely, María
An amazing clinic. We went in for an emergency and they attended to us immediately. They gave us all the care and time in the world. Great professionals!

An amazing veterinarian, always attentive and dedicated. He cared for my dog ​​with great love and professionalism until the very end, and it's clear he truly cares about animals. We couldn't have been in better hands. I wholeheartedly recommend him.

I am so grateful to Miguel and Natascha for all the care, dedication, and love they showed my dog. It's clear they truly care about their work and animals; they were attentive until the very end, even staying with us when we had to say goodbye. Thank you for all your support and kindness.
This place offers excellent care for our pets, with great professionals and very reasonable prices; it's not your typical clinic that charges exorbitant prices.
I highly recommend it. I came with my French bulldog. Everything was explained, and it was quick and comfortable.
I highly recommend them, I've been with them for a year now and they are always super professional and kind to my cat

We had to say goodbye to our very old dog here, and everything was done with the utmost care, love, and empathy, despite the pain of saying goodbye.
You can tell when you're in a veterinary clinic where the people who work there truly love animals.
Today I took my two cats to the vet, and she was so sweet ❤️ CAT-FRIENDLY ATMOSPHERE :)
The best clinic for your pets. I recommend it to everyone!

Great clinic!
The doctors are always in touch when there is a problem and have helped us with our two dogs more than once.
We are happy to have found a clinic we can trust.
Thank you!
Excellent clinic

I've been taking my cat Sasuke there since the first day I adopted him. The service is incredibly friendly, and the communication is excellent too. They explain everything right away, and you can tell they care about the animals, which makes a huge difference.

The best vet clinic. There are not many clinics out there who don’t care only about money. These vets love animals so much. This is the first clinic I have ever felt that doctors care about animals so much. Even it is a clinic, my cat feels so comfortable there. The service is wonderful, the doctors are very professional, the prices are good. I highly recommend this clinic!
Very attentive veterinarians. They registered our dog with the Spanish registry. We also received a high-quality consultation with an ultrasound, blood tests, and prescriptions.

Perfect, fast and very kind service for the reasonable price 🙏
Thanks! …
Excellent clinic, very attentive doctors! I recommend it.

My experience couldn't have been better. The veterinarian explains everything and puts you at ease when you go in to see him. The place is great, but above all, the attention and incredibly kind treatment from the staff... I would 100% recommend it to everyone in my neighborhood.
Good Russian-speaking service

We went to a clinic with our elderly dog. Other clinics didn't bother, saying it was just old age and sending us off to live out our days in pain. We ended up at this clinic on a recommendation. And these are the specialists who truly care about your pet. In my case, they found the right treatment and I completed it successfully. Thank you so much for your concern!
I called for an urgent question over the weekend, even though I'm not a customer, and they answered my query quickly and efficiently. Thank you so much for everything.
We had our dog spayed. Everything went perfectly. The vets at this clinic are true professionals!
Thank you for your help ♥️ You are the best
Thank you so much for your help. The doctors were very attentive.
Excellent clinic! First-class service. Highly recommended!

My cat Giuseppe needed a health certificate to travel to Albania and the team here was amazing. They were so gentle, helpful and kind! I moved to Valencia from the United States and they were so welcoming, welcoming me in the same day I reached out on WhatsApp. Answered my many questions! Giuseppe is a sweetheart but hates the vet (he’s Italian so he’s very “sassy” haha) they were so patient and even gave me some natural medicine for me to give to Giuseppe at home before they took blood the next morning. Would recommend them to anyone that wants their pets to be treated with the most respect and care. Thank you so much Miguel and Natacha ❤️ Giuseppe and Natasha.
Excellent and highly professional service. My dog ​​Kin always wants to go in whenever he passes by the door. I've recommended it to friends and they're delighted. Highly recommended.
Thank you so much for taking care of my cat Pinky! She has all the treatment here only
Lovely. I highly recommend them.
A good veterinary clinic. They paid a lot of attention to my shepherd. We're still getting treatment.
Today I returned to the clinic with my other dog, as always excellent service, reasonable price.

I'm very pleased with the treatment of both pets and owners. The clinic is new and clean. They don't push anything, everything is clear and to the point. The prices are reasonable. Of course, the fact that they speak Russian is a huge plus. I recommend it.
great vets, good quality of service!
I'm very happy with the way my two cats were treated. They were lovely and very professional.
The best veterinary clinic, I highly recommend it!
